## Posit Assistant (PA)

* <https://assistant.posit.co/>
* An AI agent geared towards the needs of data scientists
* Works in Positron and RStudio
* Connects to your live R and Python sessions

## Is this thing on?

![](/images/posit-assistant-hi.png)

## All the things you will confuse Posit Assistant with {.smaller}

* Posit Assistant supersedes:
  - Positron Assistant, superseded now, going away Q4 2026.
  - Databot, deprecated July 2026.
  - [A brief and biased history of Posit data science agents](https://opensource.posit.co/blog/2026-06-11_history-of-posit-data-science-agents/), June 2026 blog post by Joe Cheng
* Posit Assistant can be used with many providers
  - Posit AI Pass is one of the supported providers
  - Posit AI Pass lets you access many models through one subscription service
  - Posit AI Pass was previously known as Posit AI (no pass)

## Choose from your provider's models

![](/images/posit-assistant-model-picker.png){fig-align="center" style="max-height: 540px;"}

## `/clear` early, `/clear` often

* `/clear` begins a new conversation
* All the usual benefits of turning the thing off and back on again

![](/images/posit-assistant-clear.png)

## Conversations are not lost

* Don't worry: you can get back to earlier conversations!
  - To read
  - To resume

![](/images/posit-assistant-conversation-history.png)

## Implicit context is usually "enough"

* Posit Assistant knows, e.g.:
  - Which files you have open
  - Which file is active
  - Your current selection
  - The current workspace/folder
* You rarely need to explicitly attach a file as context
* But there are ways to explicitly attach content:
  - [Chat Features: File Attachments](https://assistant.posit.co/docs/features/chat-features/)

## Special two-way relationship with R console

* PA sees and can drive the R session in your console

![](/images/posit-assistant-r-session.png)

## Your turn {.your-turn}

* Experiment to probe how much PA knows about, e.g., the file you are looking at or your current selection
* Define a couple R objects then ask PA about them
* Prompt PA to create an R object and to mutate it
* Ask PA about itself or Positron to probe its self-knowledge
